$notes: Every user-facing string in v1, keyed by screen. Loaded by the app as Localizable source; tests scan every value against data/denylist.json.

Register: technician's voice. States what was measured and what follows. No exclamation marks anywhere in the product. No 'your score is'. No softening preamble on low scores. Percentile is against the reference distribution, never against other users.

Rules-only scorer at launch: the score definition below is the smaller, honest claim (published norms), not the calibrated-panel claim in the original bible. Swap `methodology.what_the_score_is` when v1.1 ships the calibrated model.

The app name is {app_name} everywhere. The working name 'Mog' is itself on the denylist (comparative vocabulary), which is the naming tension the bible flagged — the copy deck stays name-agnostic until that is decided.
Copy review follows the clean-copy ladder (.agents/skills/clean-copy): first ask whether a string should exist at all. Empty string = the element is not rendered.

consent.p2_body: Only measurements are kept: numbers like a canthal tilt of 4°.
consent.p3_body: Delete everything is one tap in You.

capture.profile_hint_ear: We need to see your ear and the corner of your eye
capture.skip_profile_note: Profile measurements will show as needing a capture. You can add it later from Settings.
capture.camera_purpose: Measures your face on this phone. Camera images and depth data are never saved or sent.

capture.intro: Six checks pass before it shoots.

processing.title: Measuring
processing.footnote: Computed on this iPhone. Nothing leaves it.

reveal.what_it_is: Where you start, not a verdict. About half of what makes a face appealing is personal taste no measurement captures.

results.title: Metrics
results.free_locked_note: Measured on this capture. Pro shows the values.
results.model_changed_title: Your score moved because the model changed, not because your face did
results.model_changed_body: We updated the scoring model from {old} to {new}. Your stored measurements were re-scored on this phone.
results.pro_title: All {n}, each with its reference range
results.pro_body: Your score and streak stay free.

metric_detail.reliability_B: Shown as a range: it moves more between sessions
metric_detail.reliability_C: Shown as a category: it moves too much between sessions for a number
metric_detail.fwhr_explainer: The community treats a higher ratio as desirable. A 2015 meta-analysis found the opposite. It carries no weight in the score.
metric_detail.community_explainer: No clinical norm exists. The range is the community's convention, and its score weight is near zero.
metric_detail.beard_note: Facial hair makes the jaw and chin harder to locate, so this band is wider.
metric_detail.schematic_note: Schematic face. Your numbers, not your photo.
metric_detail.geometry_note: Your measured geometry from this capture. Not stored.

paywall.title: Your score stays free.
paywall.intro: Pro is every measurement, with its value and reference range.
paywall.renewal_terms: Renews until cancelled. Cancel any time in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions. The trial becomes paid unless cancelled before it ends.
paywall.failed: The purchase didn't go through. Try again.

today.title: Today
today.scan_open_body: Same light and time of day as last time, if you can.
today.scan_locked_why: Skin and fat take weeks to show. Bone doesn't move.
today.quiet_checkin_body: If you're finding yourself checking this a lot, that's worth paying attention to. Appearance preoccupation is common and treatable. If it's weighing on you, talking to someone helps — 988 connects you to support any time.

streak.save_body: One repair a month bridges a missed day. Banked weeks stay banked either way.
streak.save_unavailable_body: This month's repair is used. The streak restarts today; banked weeks stay banked.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.intro: From your scan, ordered by what the research supports.
plan.professional_footer: We don't recommend procedures or prescriptions and we have no financial relationship with any provider.

journey.title: The path
journey.intro: A week banks at 5 of 7 days. Scans at weeks 4 and 8.
journey.finish_body: Both scans done. The plan rebuilds from the week-8 scan.

progress.title: Progress
progress.model_note: Scores are comparable across scans only on the same model version. Changes marked with a version are model changes, not face changes.
progress.empty_body: Your first delta arrives with the week-4 scan.

share.title: Share
share.photo_warning: Your capture leaves the device only if you choose to include it, and only in the image you share.

methodology.title: How the score works
methodology.what_the_score_is: Your measurements compared with published norms, weighted by evidence, as a percentile of a sex-matched reference. 0–10 is that percentile divided by ten.
methodology.what_it_is_not: Not a claim about attractiveness. About half of what makes a face appealing is personal taste. You are never rated against other users.
methodology.capture_body: It shoots only when head angle is within 3°, distance is 45–75 cm, light is even and the face is neutral and clear. Ten frames; the median is used.
methodology.metrics_body: Each measurement has a published range and two labels: how reliably it can be measured, and how strong the evidence is that it matters.
methodology.score_body: Measurements research supports carry weight. Community measurements carry almost none. Width-to-height ratio carries none: the evidence points the other way. Noisier measurements count for less.
methodology.band_body: 'Likely 5.0–7.8' is where your score should land if you scanned again. It covers movement across frames, between sessions, and the weighting itself. Never narrower than ±0.15.
methodology.tiers_body: LTN below the 45th percentile · MTN 45–65 · HTN 65–85 · Chadlite 85–97 · Chad 97 and above. There is no tier below LTN.
methodology.reference_body: Mostly Farkas's anthropometric norms, plus the clinical literature for profile angles. Ancestry never moves a score down.
methodology.privacy_body: Images, depth data and landmarks are processed and deleted on this phone. Only measurements are kept.
methodology.versions_body: Scoring model {version}. When the model changes, your measurements are re-scored here and the app says so.
methodology.reliability_target_body: We measure how much one person's score moves between sessions and publish it. Release gate: a median of 0.6 points or less.

settings.title: You
settings.consent_revoke_body: Stops measuring. Existing measurements stay until you delete them.
settings.delete_body: Wipes every measurement, plan and setting from this phone. Not recoverable.

day_done.title: Day {day}
day_done.note: The streak counts the work, never the score.
